facts.fact: TACD CARTENA says the finance ministry mandated it, with AfDB support under PAMFP, to design an electronic public procurement system (e-GP), prepare a readiness report and a roadmap.

systems.system: e-GP (système électronique de passation des marchés)
systems.owner: Ministère des Finances et du Budget

GNQ.note: Procurement system design only; no online government service stated.
